applicant_utility.summary: There is nothing to apply for here, which is exactly the trap: the only way to lose this award is to accept an offer that is not on the eligible program list, or to already hold another RMIT-funded or Australia Awards tuition scholarship. Check your intended program against RMIT's eligible list before you accept anything, because the reduction is written into the offer letter and is hard to fix afterwards. Because it is a fixed 20% off tuition, you should model the remaining 80% plus Melbourne living costs before you commit.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Citizens of India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal or Pakistan who already hold an RMIT offer for a Bachelor or Masters by Coursework place starting from a 2026 intake.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your exact program appears on RMIT's eligible program list before accepting the offer
Check you are not simultaneously holding another RMIT funded scholarship or an Australia Awards scholarship covering tuition fees
Have your student visa plan ready, because holding or intending to apply for one is part of the eligibility wording
If you hold a scholarship loan rather than a scholarship, note that RMIT says such applicants may still be considered
common_rejection_risks: Accepting an offer for a program that is not on the eligible list - the reduction will not appear
Holding another RMIT funded tuition scholarship, which is an explicit exclusion
Being an existing student who simply moves to another program within the same study level
Assuming the reduction is retroactive to offer letters issued before the 2026 intakes
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80% of tuition, plus Melbourne living costs, accommodation and overseas student health cover - the award touches fees only.
document_audit: Your offer letter is the document that proves the award, so read it line by line and query it immediately if the 20% is missing
Citizenship is assessed on passport, including dual nationals - make sure the passport you nominated matches the eligible country
Academic progress is monitored at the release of results in Semester Two of each calendar year, so keep evidence of satisfactory progress
alerts: The reduction stops being applied to the next calendar year of enrolment if you do not maintain satisfactory academic progress
Students granted the scholarship are required to participate in event coordination for RMIT's Open Day
Pathway students only get the reduction once they articulate into the eligible Bachelor or Masters by Coursework program
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit a standard international student application to RMIT; the scholarship is applied automatically and the details are set out in your offer letter.

applicant_utility.summary: Flinders is unusually explicit that this round is won on research output: successful applicants in 2026 submitted five publications, and applicants who have not published are described as unlikely to be competitive. The supervisor agreement is a hard gate rather than a nice-to-have - no supervisor at application time means no consideration, so start that conversation months before the round opens. Note also that your English test must still be valid on 31 March 2027, which invalidates older results that would otherwise look acceptable.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Overseas research graduates with a supervisor already agreed at Flinders, a genuine publication record, and an English test that stays valid into 2027.
application_readiness_checklist: Email a Flinders academic staff member in your area and secure written agreement to supervise before you start the application
Select your best five publications and complete a coversheet with a publication URL for each - missing coversheets mean publications are not considered
Book or retake your English test early enough that the result is still valid on 31 March 2027

Providing more than five publications instead of consulting your supervisor to select the best five
An English test that expires before 31 March 2027, which makes the application ineligible
Incomplete applications, which Flinders states will not be accepted
